deterministic_checks: rg -n "worker 不得嵌套 spawn implement/check" packages/cli/src/templates/guru/workflows/guru-go.md guru-template/workflows/guru-go-workflow.md

invariants.rule: Go Phase 2.1 must first run implement-slices --dry-run --backend auto and bind sub-agent/channel/inline execution to the returned dispatcher plan rather than selecting channel first.
invariants.positive_case: Both Go workflow copies contain the dry-run command, selected_backend/decision/dispatch item language, Active task prelude, and nested-dispatch guard.
invariants.negative_case: Go workflow still says to choose a backend directly from codex.dispatch_mode without reading implement-slices dry-run output.
test_evidence: rg implement-slices dry-run in Go source and mirror

invariants.rule: Go platform-specific implementation order and hard rules must remain present after adding the dispatcher prelude.
invariants.positive_case: The Go workflow still names go-implementation-guru-writing and preserves domain to app/config/main ordering, ServeMux, error wrapping, lifecycle, config, and secret constraints.
invariants.negative_case: The dispatcher edit deletes or weakens Go layer ordering, ServeMux lock, sentinel/%w/errors.Is rules, lifecycle, or secret handling.
test_evidence: rg Go platform guard terms in Go source and mirror

invariants.rule: Go [workflow-state:in_progress] breadcrumb must be dispatch-mode aware and must not describe channel as the default implementation backend.
invariants.positive_case: Both Go workflow copies tell the main session to run implement-slices --dry-run --backend auto, choose backend from selected_backend, preserve the Active task prelude, forbid nested implement/check spawn, respect dispatch_now/deferred_slices, and keep the validation-evidence reminder within the install breadcrumb budget.
invariants.negative_case: The Go in_progress breadcrumb still says default official trellis channel or omits the dispatcher dry-run prelude.
test_evidence: rg Go in_progress breadcrumb dispatcher wording
